bugs.name: Whitespace-only dashboard name passes client validation; dialog shows raw server validation text and the button turns into "Failed" (New dashboard and Duplicate dialogs)
bugs.summary: The save is refused with a raw schema message under the field — \"Value must be a non-blank string.\" — and the primary button's label changes from \"Create\" to \"Failed\" and stays that way. Nothing tells the person in plain words that the name may not be blank or only spaces, and the button now reads like a status rather than an action. The POST /api/dashboard returns 400 and two console errors are logged. (on /collection/root (New → Dashboard dialog))
bugs.expected: The Create button stays disabled for a blank/whitespace-only name, or the dialog refuses it with a plain message such as \"Name can't be blank\", and the button keeps its label so the person can correct the name and try again.
bugs.actual: The save is refused with a raw schema message under the field — \"Value must be a non-blank string.\" — and the primary button's label changes from \"Create\" to \"Failed\" and stays that way. Nothing tells the person in plain words that the name may not be blank or only spaces, and the button now reads like a status rather than an action. The POST /api/dashboard returns 400 and two console errors are logged.
reproSteps: Sign in with eval@momentic.ai / momentic-eval-1.
On /collection/root click "New" in the top bar, then "Dashboard" in the menu.
Type three spaces into the Name field of the "New dashboard" dialog and click "Create".

bugs.name: Saving a dashboard with an expired/invalid session leaves a blank white page instead of the sign-in redirect
bugs.summary: The save request (PUT /api/dashboard/6) was answered 401 Unauthenticated and the whole app went to a blank white page (title still \"Metabase\"): no error message, no redirect to the sign-in form, no notice that the edit was not saved. After reloading and signing in again the dashboard still showed the old text card, so the edit was silently lost. The console logged \"Request entities,dashboards,6,update failed: {status: 401, data: Unauthenticated}\". (on /dashboard/6-agent11-dash)
bugs.expected: When the save cannot be authenticated, the person is told the change was not saved (an error message or a redirect to the sign-in page). The unsaved edit is not silently discarded behind a blank page.
bugs.actual: The save request (PUT /api/dashboard/6) was answered 401 Unauthenticated and the whole app went to a blank white page (title still \"Metabase\"): no error message, no redirect to the sign-in form, no notice that the edit was not saved. After reloading and signing in again the dashboard still showed the old text card, so the edit was silently lost. The console logged \"Request entities,dashboards,6,update failed: {status: 401, data: Unauthenticated}\".
reproSteps: Sign in as eval@momentic.ai / momentic-eval-1 and open the dashboard /dashboard/6-agent11-dash (my own dashboard, one heading card and one text card).
Click the pencil "Edit dashboard", click the text card "maya edited this text card", type "(eval)" at the end of it.

Click "Save" in the blue "You're editing this dashboard." banner after the session behind the tab has ended (in my run the session had already been invalidated, so the save hit an unauthenticated request).
Watch the page, then reload and read the console/network.

A second click on the same button then does exit fullscreen. Seen 3 times out of 3 with this sequence; entering fullscreen from the menu and exiting immediately, without a reload, works on the first click.

It saves like that (PUT /api/dashboard/25 → 200) and after a reload the dashboard shows the same broken card with the same generic message and no hint of what is wrong. bugs.actual: Clicking 'Done' with the snippet box empty creates the card anyway, with no validation message at the field and no warning: the card immediately shows only "There was a problem rendering this content." (a lock icon and that one sentence). It saves like that (PUT /api/dashboard/25 → 200) and after a reload the dashboard shows the same broken card with the same generic message and no hint of what is wrong.
